item.title: Reliquary Magic Expansion Add-On
item.creator: 5 Frame Studios
item.description:
Reliquary Magic Expansion Add-On introduces various new magical Staves & Items to your world! 

+ 3D Animated Magical Staff models
+ Magical Charms
+ New magical blocks
+ Custom Potions

This is the Bedrock-ported version of the Reliquary Reincarnations mod.

item.howToTitle: How to Charge and Use Magic Staves

howToEntries.heading: Charging a Stave
howToEntries.content:
Magic Staves must have a charge to use their magical abilities. Each Stave requires a specific item to charge. For example, the Rending Gale uses Feathers.

Hover over the Stave in your inventory to see its required Charge Item and Charge Amount. A Stave's magical ability will only work if its charge is above 0.

Gather the required charge items in your inventory. While holding the Stave, Sneak + Interact to enter Charge Mode. Make sure you have the correct items in your inventory. Sneak + Interact again to exit Charge Mode.

howToEntries.heading: Using Magical Abilities
howToEntries.content:
Interact while holding a Stave to activate its magical ability. Using a magical ability will consume some of the Stave's charge.

Some Staves have multiple ability modes. While Sneaking, move your selected inventory slot left or right to cycle between the Stave's available modes.
